name: Conditional Adversarial Loss
definition: A loss function to prevent blurry or distorted artifacts in novel views by using a conditional discriminator that distinguishes artifacts in rendered images compared with target images, using fine-grained information from the same viewpoint to prevent GAN mode collapse.
summary: Conditional Adversarial Loss is a regularization term that enforces photorealism and 3D consistency in volume rendering by using a discriminator to evaluate image pairs from the same viewpoint, preventing mode collapse and blurry artifacts.
